read.thesis: Record Q3 with core NNA $190B (+38%) and 800bp operating leverage, but full-year revenue and NIM guided to low end as loan growth outpaces deposits and cash funding tightens.

triggers.label: Core NNA $190B, up 38%
triggers.quote: We attracted $190 billion in core net new assets in the third quarter, up 38% over last year
triggers.highlight: $190 billion in core net new assets

triggers.label: Revenue and NIM to low end
